card.name: Just before a unit of measure
card.fires_on: Marks the spot just before a unit or scale word is expected, such as the opening parenthesis in table headers before kg, mL or hr, or a number or quantity word before million, hundred or acres.

modes.label: Table header parenthesis
modes.description: The opening bracket after a column name such as Body Weight or Infusion Rate, right before the unit.
modes.example: CLINIMIX 6/5 CLINIMIX 8/10 CLINIMIX 8/14 Infusion Rate Range<< (>>mL/kg/hr) 0.

modes.label: Number before a scale word
modes.description: A digit or quantity word that is followed by million, hundred, acres or micrograms/mL.
modes.example: The total cattle biomass would be greater than ours (more than 50<<0>> million tons)

card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a unit or a size word like million or kg.
